verdict.line: You lose if you let Illaoi stack W (Harsh Lesson) resets on tentacle procs in melee trades; you win if you poke with Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) from range and deny her E (Test of Spirit) value.

brief.thesis: Illaoi holds lane and solo-kill advantage over Ornn (50.5% Illaoi win rate over 853 games) because her W (Harsh Lesson) lets her dash in and reset off tentacle swings, and melee-trading with her sustains her through Prophet of an Elder God healing. Ornn's size makes him an easy target for her E (Test of Spirit), so the matchup is won or lost on whether you can poke and disengage instead of standing and swinging.

theirWindow.when: she lands E (Test of Spirit) on you
theirWindow.what: Once Test of Spirit is on you, back off immediately or the echo damage and tentacle swings from Prophet of an Elder God stack fast. Do not trade through it.

yourWindow.when: her E (Test of Spirit) is on cooldown (12-16s)
yourWindow.what: Step up and throw Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow and chip damage, then walk the magma pillar zone to deny her approach. This is your only safe damage window since melee trades favor her sustain.

powerCurve.note: Her W (Harsh Lesson) dash wins early all-ins
E (Test of Spirit) stacks tentacle damage hard
Your R (Call of the Forge God) threatens her engages
Thornmail and Bramble Vest punish her auto-resets
Teamfights decide it, not side lane

start.why: The 49.4% win rate over 658 games and 63.4% pick rate reflect that the bonus health and poke-sustain outheal her tentacle chip damage while you farm from range.

boots.why: At 50.7% over 807 games and an 83.3% pick rate, the attack-speed reduction specifically dulls her auto-attacks and tentacle procs that rely on landing hits to heal her.

core.why: Early armor plus grievous wounds directly counters her Prophet of an Elder God lifesteal from tentacle hits.
Core path (53.8% over 39 games) gives health and AoE damage that punishes her for standing near you in extended trades.
Reflect damage and grievous wounds scale directly against an opponent who wins through sustained melee contact and healing.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need resistances that scale through extended fights
she is building toward true damage or armor penetration to cut through your stacking resistances
her team adds heavy magic damage threats alongside her physical pressure

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustain from last-hitting minions near her wins the war of attrition without needing to engage her in prolonged melee trades where she has the edge.

summoners.why: At 51.3% win rate over the 21.9% of games running it, Flash+Ignite punishes her all-in commitments from W (Harsh Lesson) when she overextends without sustain backup.

playing.title: Never auto-trade in melee
playing.detail: Her Prophet of an Elder God tentacles heal her off every hit she lands on you, so standing and trading autos is a losing exchange. Use Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) to poke instead.

playing.title: Save E for her E cast
playing.detail: When she casts E (Test of Spirit) on you, immediately use E (Searing Charge) to put distance or knock her back if she's near terrain, denying the echo damage window.

playing.title: Track her Q cooldown for tentacle fights
playing.detail: Her Q (Tentacle Smash) on a 10-6s cooldown increases tentacle damage near terrain. Avoid fighting her adjacent to walls or structures where tentacles can spawn.

playing.title: Use R to punish her dives
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God on a 140-100s cooldown can redirect the elemental into her if she commits W (Harsh Lesson) onto you, turning her engage into a knockup punish.

playing.title: Farm from max range
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to stay behind minions and avoid her E (Test of Spirit); treat this as a farm lane, not a kill lane, until items like Thornmail come online.

playing.title: Itemize grievous wounds early
playing.detail: Bramble Vest and Thornmail directly cut the healing that lets her win extended fights, so prioritize them over pure damage items.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi is not a difficult opponent if you dodge her (E), but Ornn’s size makes him an easy target for her. Stay behind minions to avoid her (E). You cannot defeat Illaoi in melee combat, so try to farm lane safely from a distance.
